''See also: [[Renfei Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Renfei, also known as Pai Ren, was a member of the [[Skysworn]]. She was a [[Truegold]] who possessed a hammer and utilized [[Cloud Hammer madra]], which she could spread into a protective haze. In combat or movement, she often utilized emerald green [[Thousand-Mile Cloud|Thousand-Mile Clouds]], which are symbols of the [[Skysworn]], and was accompanied by a personal raincloud [[Goldsign]]. Renfei was characterized by her composed and controlled demeanor, appearing calm and ready to act even when facing high-pressure situations. As a member of the [[Skysworn]], she served the [[Blackflame Empire]] and was tasked with supervising trainees and maintaining high organizational standards. Her career included earning her way into the [[Skysworn]] through training, and she eventually died following a single attack from [[Akura Harmony]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Renfei has black hair styled in a tail and is accompanied by a gray cloud hovering over her head. She carries a dark hammer.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|She possesses an authoritative voice and maintains a calm, composed temperament. As a member of the [[Skysworn]], she performs duties such as scanning hosts before they are allowed into the group.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Renfei is the partner of [[Bai Rou]]. She is also connected to [[Mercy]], who has mentioned her, and [[Naru Gwei]], who is involved with her. Additionally, Renfei assisted [[Lindon]] by helping to drag him into a building.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Renfei follows the [[Path of the Cloud Hammer]] and utilizes [[Cloud Hammer madra]]. Her techniques include generating dark platforms of solid cloud to stand on and using dark clouds as an attack.}}
